summary: Iteration 10 - Email Verification Flow Testing Complete. All 15 backend tests passed. All frontend E2E tests passed. Email verification flow working correctly: registration returns requires_verification:true (not token), unverified users see orange verification message on login (not red error), admin bypasses verification, profile page hides business fields for nepodnikatel customers.

issues: Uses browser's default date picker instead of custom shadcn calendar component - minor UX inconsistency (carried over from iteration 9)

seed_data_creation: Multiple test users created during testing with unique emails (test-*@example.com) - all unverified
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email verification flow fully tested and working. Key behaviors: 1) POST /api/auth/register returns {message, email, requires_verification:true} - NO token. 2) POST /api/auth/login returns 403 with detail='EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED' for unverified users. 3) Admin users bypass verification check. 4) Frontend shows orange verification message (not red error) when EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED. 5) Profile page hides IČO, DIČ, Název firmy, Sídlo, Pobočka for nepodnikatel customers. 6) Photo upload in registration uses direct label+hidden-input (no dropdown menu).

LOGIN_VERIFIED_RETURNS_TOKEN.details: POST /api/auth/login with verified email returns access_token and user data

ADMIN_BYPASSES_VERIFICATION.details: Admin login works regardless of is_verified status

RESEND_VERIFICATION_ENDPOINT.details: POST /api/auth/resend-verification accepts email and returns success

FRONTEND_LOGIN_VERIFICATION_MESSAGE.details: When EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, login page shows orange verification message with resend button (not red error)
